verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage is documented as a first-class feature with fine-grained access controls enforced via Postgres RLS policies on buckets/objects, plus on-the-fly image transformation and 'optimized delivery' for fast global serving, and it's referenced as a core product pillar alongside Auth/DB/Edge Functions. Missing for 10: explicit CDN/edge-network technical details or independent benchmarks proving CDN-backed performance, and community feedback notes some rough edges (e.g., lack of metadata support).
